The exact Proposition2.4 statement on printedp.680 was read. DT supplies the complete independent projection-formula, Serre-vanishing and Leray argument. A mistaken initial render displayedp.681; that filename/page distinction is explicitly recorded.

The full Theorem4.1 statement on printedp.124 was actually viewed again. A proper map and coherent sheaf have a locally finite-rank free complex; for a relatively flat sheaf it is bounded. The Poincare/vector-bundle families are relatively flat, so rank conditions yield the local analytic jump loci. No full pp.124–130 proof reading is claimed.
